original_test_intent: Verify the correct BMC Manager exposes the expected Redfish EthernetInterfaces collection and that its logical interface members, link properties and address identities match the approved platform inventory.
original_method: Discover the Manager and EthernetInterfaces link, retrieve the collection and approved members with secure read-only bounded GETs, validate schema/count/unique identities, redact sensitive network addresses and compare interface/link/address fields to the owner topology matrix.
manual_activity: The owner supplies the expected physical/logical interface inventory and allowed address evidence, then adjudicates mapping/link correctness.
required_inputs: Exact BMC/Manager/firmware/API identity and expected interface count
Logical Redfish member IDs to physical management-port mapping
Required InterfaceEnabled, LinkStatus, Speed, MAC/address/VLAN/name fields and acceptable values
Pagination/member bounds plus TLS/protected credential references
Network-identifier redaction and evidence retention policy
safety_requirements: Use verified TLS and protected credentials; never -k or root password on command line
GET only; prohibit PATCH of interfaces and NetworkProtocol/network configuration
Bound collection/member traversal and response size
Redact MAC/IP/hostname/VLAN/topology according to policy while preserving comparisons/hashes
Stop on wrong Manager, duplicate/unknown member, schema/auth failure or unsafe-to-retain data
agent_execution_scope: Discover and verify exact Manager/EthernetInterfaces resource and owner matrix
GET collection and approved members read-only under bounds
Validate ResourceType/schema/count/unique IDs and required link/address fields
Apply redaction and produce logical-to-physical comparison/discrepancy evidence
Perform no network mutation or independent port mapping guess
engineer_actions: Provide expected interface/member/physical-port matrix and field values
Approve sensitive network-data policy and acceptable link/address states
Review mapping evidence and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The collection GET matches the source, but curl -k/CLI credentials, unresolved Manager and pretty-print output do not validate member count/schema, physical mapping or sensitive-data policy.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use a certificate-validating Redfish client to discover and read the collection/members, enforce bounds, schema-check and redact network identities before comparing to the approved port matrix.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Manager EthernetInterfaces collection, response correctness and 5/5-minute estimates remain; literal manager bmc and root/0penBmc are treated as unsafe placeholders.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a normalized inventory keyed by immutable member @odata.id/MAC hash, compare unique count and link/enable/speed/address attributes to a signed physical-port matrix and emit a redacted difference report.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds identity discovery, member completeness, topology reconciliation and confidentiality controls beyond insecure JSON display.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Collection reachability cannot establish that all and only required ports exist or that link/address values map to the correct physical management interfaces.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Virtual, aggregate or inactive interfaces and dynamic addresses can be legitimate. Their expected membership/state must come from the project matrix, not generic assumptions.

project_override_considerations: Dynamic/DHCP addresses and OEM interfaces may be redacted or represented differently, but each expected/extra member needs an explicit project disposition rather than omission.
expected_evidence: Exact source row/variant/hash and BMC/Manager/firmware/API/schema/TLS identity
Protected-session/GET-only audit and discovered collection URI
Redacted collection/member payload hashes, count/pagination/unique-member/schema validation
Per-interface enable/link/speed/address comparison and logical-to-physical mapping
Redaction/no-network-write audit, discrepancy list and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria coherently target the Manager EthernetInterfaces collection. Missing topology oracle, unsafe placeholders and confidentiality handling are execution-readiness gaps.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Exact inventory/mapping and privacy inputs gate execution but do not prevent complete static review.

review_improvement: Makes collection correctness a bounded member/topology comparison and protects management addressing while keeping the test strictly read-only.
independent_technical_reasoning: An EthernetInterfaces collection is not self-interpreting: logical members can include disabled, virtual or service interfaces, so correctness depends on a platform-specific mapping. Count alone is insufficient because a missing physical port can be offset by an unexpected virtual member. Per-member identity and uniqueness must therefore precede attribute comparison. Since MAC/IP/topology data can enable management-plane targeting, the artifact should retain hashes and expected comparisons without exporting unrestricted raw identifiers.
